title: Database and information-systems coursework with an LMS chatbot
summary: Students in database and information-systems education use an LLM-driven chatbot integrated with Moodle while working through course learning activities. The chatbot supports self-regulated learning and help seeking by answering course-related questions within the learning-management environment.

sources.title: An LLM-Driven Chatbot in Higher Education for Databases and Information Systems

assessment.summary: Complete database and information-systems coursework with an embedded Moodle chatbot available for help.
student_actions: Ask the chatbot course-related questions and apply its responses.

student_role.description: Students interact with the LMS-integrated chatbot during course activities.

assessment_system_role: Provide contextual help and support self-regulated learning.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
